title: High Protein Orzo Chicken Bake
description: One-dish baked orzo with chicken, chorizo and vegetables, finished with cream cheese stirred through after baking.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 203 (Simple High Protein Orzo Chicken Pasta). Rated 9/10.

confidence.note: Amounts as given in the creator's caption. The caption doesn't say how to cut the chicken or chorizo; bite-sized pieces are assumed. Not yet cooked and confirmed at home.

nutrition.note: As stated by the source; not independently checked. Fibre figure not captured.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Combine the orzo ({{orzo}}), chicken ({{chicken}}), chorizo ({{chorizo}}), capsicums ({{capsicums}}), cherry tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), spinach ({{spinach}}), paprika ({{paprika}}), salt, pepper and stock ({{stock}}) in a baking dish and mix well. Keep the cream cheese aside.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Remove from the oven and stir through the cream cheese ({{cream-cheese}}) until smooth and creamy. Serve.
